sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game's controls are intuitive, with players using their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to move their bird left and right, as well as jump and fly. But don't be fooled by the simplicity of the controls - the challenges presented by Shadobirds are far from it.

       As players progress through the game, they will encounter a variety of obstacles, including birds, black shadows, and treacherous terrain. These obstacles will require players to use their quick reflexes and strategic thinking to overcome, and the game's AI will adapt to the player's level of skill, ensuring that even the most skilled players will find themselves facing challenges that push them to their limits.
